title: Flat-plan accounts read 'flat plan' and unmetered sessions one line per account
description: Seeded usage for an account with a monthly fee on an unpriced model, an account with neither price nor fee, and two sessions on a runtime that reports no tokens: master usage and the Costs API show 'flat plan' for the fee account, 'price unknown' for the other, and one line '<account>: 2 sessions not metered by <runtime>' outside the totals line.
